answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Signed professional reference letter with former employer attestation. It demands a reference the former employer signed after years of working together, and the velvet is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The timber is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk. The harbor is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
